annotations.title: Is this lodging in the licence register

description: 한국 여행 안내·관광 통계 (Korea Basics): Look up a place to stay in Korea's local licensing records by the address or name on a booking confirmation (the address works best; romanized addresses are matched by their numbers). Returns the matching business with its type, registration month and address, a closure record, or that it could not be confirmed. Not being confirmed does not mean a place is unlicensed: the name may differ or the record may lag.

query.description: The address or business name as written on the booking, e.g. "22-4 Jahamun-ro 33-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul" or "Lotte Hotel Seoul".
